related.note: Grusch and others claiming real reverse-engineering programs with craft in hangars is a general claim akin to the Age of Disclosure program claims.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to a documentary film called The Age of Disclosure. He says that in it, people like Jim Semivan, who was high up at the CIA, and Chris Mellon, a former senior Pentagon intelligence official, say the US has a programme for reverse engineering recovered craft, meaning taking them apart to learn how they work. If true, it would mean the government holds technology it did not build.
